parametrized_description: A municipality hires full-time and part-time staff to deliver mail. Part-time staff works PartTimeHours hours per week and gets paid PartTimePayment dollars whereas a full-time staff works FullTimeHours hours every week and gets paid FullTimePayment dollars for that week. Since it is the week leading up to a holiday, planning ahead, the municipality needs TotalLaborHours hours of mail staff labor. The municipality has a budget of TotalBudget dollars for mail delivery for this season. How many of each type of staff should the municipality hire to decrease the total number of staff?

NumFullTime.description: Number of full-time staff to hire

NumPartTime.description: Number of part-time staff to hire

constraints.description: Number of full-time staff is non-negative
Number of part-time staff is non-negative
Total hours worked by part-time and full-time staff must meet TotalHoursRequired

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(FullTimeHours * NumFullTime + PartTimeHours * NumPartTime >= TotalHoursRequired, name="TotalHoursConstr")

constraints.description: Total payment to part-time and full-time staff is at most TotalBudget

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(FullTimeWage * NumFullTime + PartTimeWage * NumPartTime <= TotalBudget, name="BudgetConstr")

objective.description: Minimize the total number of full-time and part-time staff hired
